defs.def: the ability to see 视力；视觉

ex.s: In recent years some Inuit people in Nunayut   65   (report) increases in bear sightings around human settlements, leading to a   66   (believe) that populations are increasing.
ex.t: 近年来，努纳武特的一些因纽特人___65___（report）在人类聚居地附近看到熊的次数增加，导致一种种群在增长的___66___（believe）。

ex.s: Today, they are once again a familiar sight, playing roles that are often just as important for the community as their original purpose.
ex.t: 随着Inglis和其他后来的商人开始工作，改造后的电话亭开始在城镇和村庄重新出现，因为人们发现了它们的新用途。

ex.s: He lost his sight but found a _____54_____.
ex.t: 他失去了视力，却找到了___54___。

ex.s: If I can get so much pleasure from touch, how much more beauty must be revealed by sight?
ex.t: 如果我能从触觉中获得如此多的快乐，那么视觉必定能揭示出多少更多的美啊？

defs.def: the act of seeing sb/sth 看见

ex.s: catch sight ofB. make room for
ex.t: 看到 B. 为……腾出空间

defs.def: the area or distance within which sb can see or sth can be seen 视力范围；视野

ex.s: Soon after that, around 192 lakes in northwestern Alaska are gone from sight.
ex.t: 不久之后，阿拉斯加西北部大约192个湖泊消失了。

ex.s: Then she flew quickly out of sight.
ex.t: 然后她迅速飞出了视线。

ex.s: The end of the school year was in sight and spirits were high.
ex.t: 我在离开15年后重返讲坛，面对从书包里掏出来的各种"禁品"。

ex.s: I was frightened at the sight of the test paper.
ex.t: 过了一会儿，保罗叔叔和他的农舍就从视线中消失了。

defs.def: a thing that you see or can see 看见（或看得见）的事物；景象；情景

ex.s: In1980, Benchley was diving when he came across an awful sight.
ex.t: 1980年，本奇利在潜水时偶然目睹了一幅可怕的景象。

ex.s: What did the sight of the violins in that little shop bring to Tara's mind?
ex.t: 看到那家小店里的小提琴， Tara想到了什么？

ex.s: "We can rule out that the dogs simply distinguish between the pictures based on a simple cue, such as the sight of teeth," said study author Corsin Muller.
ex.t: “我们可以排除狗只是根据诸如看到牙齿这样简单的线索来区分这些图片的可能性，”研究作者Corsin Muller说。

ex.s: Darkness would make him more appreciative of sight; silence would teach him the joys of sound.
ex.t: 而且在鸟巢里，还伴随着最壮观的景象——午餐！

ex.s: As grizzly bears expand their range into places where they haven’t been seen in a century or more, they’re increasingly being sighted by humans.
ex.t: 随着灰熊的活动范围扩展到它们一个多世纪未见的地方，它们越来越多地被人类看到。

ex.s: After a while Uncle Paul and his fam house were out of sight.
ex.t: 过了一会儿，保罗叔叔和他的农舍看不见了。

defs.def: the interesting places, especially in a town or city, that are often visited by tourists 名胜；风景

ex.s: to form a beautiful sight of the city
ex.t: 以形成城市的一道美丽风景

ex.s: But of all the senses, I am sure that sight must be the most delightful.
ex.t: 第2段：我们驾车穿过好几个州，沿途看到了许多美丽的风景。

ex.s: That means you have tons of less-visited options to choose from. ___18___ Why not try a regional alternative or check out a popular destination’s lesser-known sights?
ex.t: 这意味着你有大量游客较少的选择。___18____ 为什么不试试区域性的替代之地，或去看看热门目的地鲜为人知的景点？

defs.def: a person or thing that looks ridiculous, untidy, unpleasant, etc. 滑稽可笑（或邋遢、脏乱、讨厌）的人（或物）

ex.s: “I’ll see you back home in a month, okay?” His parents nodded, and they watched as he walked out of sight into the crowds of hundreds of students and parents.
ex.t: “一个月后家里见，好吗？”他的父母点点头，看着他消失在数百名学生和家长的人海中。

ex.s: Nature seems to unfold to people who watch and wait． Next time you take a walk， no matter where it is， take in all the sights， sounds and sensations． Wander in this frame of mind and you will open a new dimension to your life．
ex.t: 大自然似乎向那些观察和等待的人展开。下次你散步时，无论在哪里，都要领略所有的景色、声音和感觉。带着这种心态闲逛，你会为生活打开一个新的维度。

ex.s: Blind people recognize shapes with their ____40____ (exist) senses, in a way similar to that of ____41____ (sight )people, says Ella Striem-Amit, a Harvard scientist.
ex.t: 盲人用他们的____40____ (exist)现有感官识别形状，方式与____41____ (sight )视力正常的人相似，哈佛科学家Ella Striem-Amit说。

ex.s: And it was accompanied in the nest by the greatest sight of all — LUNCH!
ex.t: 去年，莫兰从事一个项目，将法茨·沃勒的音乐编排成舞会音乐，"只是为了让人们重新认识到沃勒的音乐既是舞蹈音乐也是音乐会音乐，"莫兰说。

defs.def: a device that you look through to aim a gun, etc. or to look at sth through a telescope, etc. 瞄准具；观测器

ex.s: Para2:  We drove through several states and saw lots of great sights along the way.
ex.t: 第2段:我们开车经过几个州,看到沿途有许多伟大的景色。

defs.def: when you first begin to consider sth 乍一看；初看时

ex.s: My two sets of grandparents lived in Colorado and North Dakota, and my parents decided to spend a few weeks driving to those states and seeing all the sights along the way.
ex.t: 我的两对祖父母分别住在科罗拉多州和北达科他州，父母决定花几周时间开车去那些州，沿途看遍所有景点。

ex.s: When he was_____32_____outside, the only_____33_____in sight was a policeman.

defs.def: when you see sb/sth for the first time 初次见到
to become no longer able to see sb/sth 再也见不着
to stop considering sth; to forget sth 忽略；忘记

ex.s: Sometimes we lose sight that the music has a wider context,” says Moran, “so I want to continue those dialogues.
ex.t: “有时我们忽略了音乐有更广阔的语境，”莫兰说，“所以我想延续那些对话。”

ex.s: 38   “I think a point that many people lose sight of is how easy it can be to fall behind schedule,” says graduate student Amanda Bindman.
ex.t: 38 “我认为很多人忽视的一点是，落后于计划是多么容易的事情，”研究生阿曼达·宾德曼说。

ex.s: The most rewarding day for our group was project day，when all the efforts we put into collecting the items finally came together．When I saw the various supplies we had collected，it hit me that every kit we were to build that day would eventually be in the hands of an Iraqi child．Over the past four months，I had never imagined how I would feel once our project was completed．While making the kits，I realized that I had lost sight of the true meaning behind it．I had only focused on the fact that it was another school project and one I wanted to get a good grade on．When the kits were completed，and ready to be sent overseas，the warm feeling I had was one I would never forget．
ex.t: 对我们小组来说最有收获的一天是项目日，那天我们为收集物资付出的所有努力终于汇聚在一起。当我看到我们收集到的各种物资时，我突然意识到，那天我们要制作的每一个套装最终都会送到一个伊拉克孩子手中。在过去的四个月里，我从未想象过项目完成后自己会有怎样的感受。在制作这些套装的过程中，我意识到自己已经忽略了它背后的真正意义——我只顾着把它当成又一个学校项目，而且是我想要拿高分的一个。当这些套装制作完成、准备送往海外时，那种温暖的感觉我将永远铭记。
